drhp.business: The Company manufactures industrial air compressors and air-treatment equipment and provides comprehensive solutions including installation, commissioning and maintenance. Air Solutions is the only segment in the Company's operations, and its products are primarily sold to industries in the automotive, metals, pharmaceutical and textile sectors. Alongside equipment sales, the growing installed base supports an aftermarket in preventive maintenance, spare parts, energy audits, rentals, upgrades and system optimisation services.

risks.note: The Company states the external risk environment is increasingly persistent, interconnected and difficult to predict, with geopolitical developments, supply chain volatility and macroeconomic shifts continuing to influence energy and input costs, logistics and freight dynamics, and the availability of critical supplies. This has shortened planning cycles and increased the need for preparedness against low-probability, high-impact events.
risks.risk: Persistent and interconnected external risk environment

risks.note: Identified in the BRSR as both risk and opportunity. Climate-related strategic, physical and transitional (market and compliance) risks are becoming steadily more relevant to the business and, if not managed properly, can affect operations and profitability; mitigation is aligned with the parent organization's 2030 and 2050 goals, with site-specific KPIs at the Naroda facility. Negative financial implication cited is increased operating costs in meeting those goals and targets.

The BRSR flags that inability to develop new products and technologies can impair the Company's competitive position, which could affect sales and market share. Mitigation is continued investment in technology innovation, new efficiency models across rotary oil-flooded and oil-free screw compressors, centrifugal upgrades, an expanded heat-of-compression desiccant dryer portfolio and the Ecoplant digital platform.

The BRSR cites higher investments required to meet stringent regulatory requirements on energy-efficient product design as a negative financial implication of the product stewardship and innovation material issue.
risks.risk: Regulatory cost of energy-efficient product design

risks.note: The BRSR identifies the need to spot human rights risk within operational processes, which could otherwise create reputational or legal risk, alongside the dependence of productivity and operations on employee wellbeing, upskilling and deployment of employee skills.
risks.risk: Human rights, labour and talent risk

risks.note: Material related-party transactions with Industrial Technologies and Services LLC, USA exceed the SEBI materiality threshold and require shareholder approval, with the resolution placed before the ensuing AGM - a recurring dependence on the parent group that is subject to annual member approval.
risks.risk: Related-party concentration with the group counterparty

risks.note: The BRSR reports Air Solutions - manufacturing of air compressors, spare parts and components, installation and commissioning, and air accessories - as 100% of turnover, with manufacture of pumps/compressors/taps and valves at 91% and installation services at 9%, leaving the Company fully exposed to one product-market cycle.

Exports contribute 19% of total turnover per the BRSR, exposing the Company to overseas demand, trade policy and currency conditions in addition to its PAN-India base of 28 states and 8 Union Territories.
